name: setup-milty-slice-after-faction-order
description: Live pbd223 stall (08:48): round 3 of a 5-player milty draft, Bot Zeta 6 (seat5) already holds a faction and speaker position and owes a slice. The slice board's decision was closed as obsolete mid-draft (a half-loaded MiltyDraftManager seen by a concurrent edit capture), so only the faction / speaker boards were open; the bot pressed those, both were refused ('You already drafted…'), and the draft never advanced. Here: seat4 takes speaker position 4, then seat5 must be able to take a slice through the engine, then seat3 a faction (the last seat's speaker position is auto-picked and the draft finishes).
